title: a-ha - Take On Me (Official Video) [4K]
summary: The official remastered 4K video for a-ha's 1985 hit, famous for its rotoscoped pencil-sketch animation blending live action and comic-book drawings. It won six MTV Video Music Awards in 1986.
why: It is mostly a cultural touchstone on HN, cited for its sketch animation style or the song itself rather than recommended as something to learn from.

quote.text: reminds me of the animation style of the 1980s music video "Take On Me" by the band a-ha
